description: This file defines the LegacyMPDFEngine class, a PDF engine implementation for SuiteCRM using the mPDF library. It includes methods for writing HTML, headers, footers, configuring PDF settings, and outputting PDFs.

classes.name: LegacyMPDFEngine
classes.description: A class extending PDFEngine that provides PDF generation functionalities using the mPDF library within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mPDF object, optionally with a provided instance.

methods.name: writeHTML
methods.description: Writes HTML content to the PDF, with special handling for section 1 (header CSS).

methods.name: outputPDF
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF to a file or stream, returning the output if successful.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Sets the HTML header for the PDF.

methods.name: writeFooter
methods.description: Sets the HTML footer for the PDF.

methods.name: addCSS
methods.description: Adds CSS styling to the PDF by writing it as HTML with section 1.

methods.name: writeBlankPage
methods.description: Adds a blank page to the PDF.

methods.name: configurePDF
methods.description: Configures the PDF settings by loading a configuration mapping and creating a new mPDF instance.
